cases.question: Why does the model use CAMS as an input if CAMS is wrong?
cases.answer: Even though CAMS can be inaccurate on its own (with an overall MAE of 9.07 compared to ground measurements), our model uses it as a useful baseline signal and achieves a much better overall MAE of 5.202 by correcting CAMS errors using local data.
